title: Rotterdam Orphanage
summary: The Rotterdam Orphanage was a children's home in Rotterdam, Netherlands where Zhalia Moon, Den and Harrison Fears grew up. It was a miserable place with poor living conditions, and where systematic bullying and mistreatment was rife among the children who lived there. Harrison described it as a "prison". It was run by its caretaker Ms. Shrodinger until it was taken over by the Blood Spiral in search of recruits.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Zhalia Moon]] was grew up here as a child but was eventually left for the streets before being found and raised by [[Klaus]], an [[Organization]] [[Seeker]]. {{Source|The Vampire Loses Its Fangs}}

Many years later, following a reunion with her adoptive father, [[Klaus]], and witnessing her one-time home at [[Klaus' bookshop]] burn to the ground, Zhalia returned to her old orphanage and noted it hadn't changed much. [[Tantras]] and the [[Blood Spiral]] arrived in search of vulnerable orphans who they could recruit. After tying up Ms. Shrodinger, Tantras began training the orphans, teaching them spells and giving them [[Titans]]. {{source|Den vs Harrison}}
